name: probatorium-hono-server
//build: Bundles src/server.ts into a single dist/server file via Bun's native bundler. --target=bun keeps Bun built-ins (Bun.serve, etc.) external; --minify shaves bytes; --sourcemap=none keeps deploys lean. The wrapper script written by the ansible build step then execs `bun run dist/server` so the runtime is Bun, not node.
//run: `bun run dist/server` is the canonical entry — invoked by the launcher symlink the ansible build_native_competitor task creates. CLI args after `--` are forwarded to the script (Bun.argv).
//versions: Always-latest policy: deps use unbounded `latest` so `bun install` resolves the newest cut at deploy time. Do NOT pin — the bench is meant to track upstream as-is.
